nodes.label: LGMD v4 Header Fix
nodes.rationale: Decision to rewrite LGMD v4 header count bytes 66..69 to prevent crashes caused by stale vhot counts.

nodes.label: Funk Mesh Non-Root Node Deletion
nodes.rationale: In Funk Mesh, a missing imported non-root subobject mesh node means 'delete all original faces from this preserved subobject.' This allows workflows like removing hand mesh nodes in Max while preserving subobject/joint identity for animation/PointRig references.

nodes.label: Separate LGMM Import from LGMD Export
nodes.rationale: Keep LGMM support as read-only to prevent accidental routing through LGMD export functions, which would produce invalid assets since LGMM is segmented/skinned and LGMD is static.

nodes.label: Flatlit Left-Hand Baseline
nodes.rationale: Restore ss2vr_ls with shaded 0 as the only known-visible standalone custom hand fallback. Other variants (lk, lm, ln) were invisible or caused crashes.

nodes.label: FlatAim Reticle Offset Native Proof
nodes.rationale: Use a read-only DLL probe of native Shock overlay slot 22 to identify the native rect/anchor instead of tuning Squirrel offsets, as the WorldToScreen path was facing-dependent.

nodes.label: Canonical Aim/Facing Conventions
nodes.rationale: Single-source Dark-engine math in docs/CONVENTIONS.md to prevent drift between SS2VR and FlatAim. Added missing engine-convention helpers to ss2vr_weapon_probe.nut.

nodes.label: Package Material Include Chains
nodes.rationale: Custom .mtl files in KPF must inline render passes or package all dependencies locally because relative paths to base materials failed/crashed.

nodes.label: View-Frame Aim/Pose System
nodes.rationale: Treat controller pose as a full frame (origin, forward, right, up). Derive CameraObj bank from forward+up to avoid pole/roll weirdness at pitch extremes found in FlatAim testing.

nodes.label: Linear Snap-Turn Gain
nodes.rationale: Set snap_turn_pixels_per_degree back to 1.0 after F3 capture proved the 1.4 gain was the source of error in snap-v2 accumulator path.

nodes.label: FlatAim PointRig FX Attachment
nodes.rationale: Reuse native viewmodel PointRig helpers (muzzleFlashPoint, vhotN) for muzzle flash and shell ejection to ensure visuals follow the mode-7 freeaim proxy pose.

nodes.label: Squirrel Camera.GetFacing Mapping
nodes.rationale: Read Camera.GetFacing() as (x=bank, y=pitch, z=heading). Previous code incorrectly used .x as heading, causing world-north alignment bugs.

nodes.label: Gravity-Glove Hand-Follow Hold
nodes.rationale: Hand objects into the existing grab/hold lane after a glove catch to make them feel held rather than floating at a beam point.

nodes.label: Mono VR Selection Marker
nodes.rationale: Compute OpenXR selection brackets from pre-eye mono view (flatResidualView) to prevent doubling/lag caused by per-eye IPD offsets.

nodes.label: Manual Reload Tier 1
nodes.rationale: Implement manual reload as a gesture detector dispatching native unload_gun/reload_gun commands to avoid duplicating complex weapon state logic.

nodes.label: Two-Handed Weapon Constraint
nodes.rationale: Right hand remains primary owner; left hand acts as a secondary support constraint to avoid conflicting CameraObj writes from two controllers.

nodes.label: Native Selection Suppression
nodes.rationale: Hide native crosshair and clear native frob globals while controllers are tracking to prevent multiple selection systems from fighting visually.

nodes.label: Native Movement Command Bridge
nodes.rationale: Use Debug.Command to send +walkfast etc. as a first proof of native movement before attempting direct axis/locomotion hooks.

nodes.label: Authoritative View Baseline
nodes.rationale: In authoritative mode, express CameraObj fields by projecting controller world pose back into the native KEX camera frame to fix HMD-bleed/drift.

nodes.label: Squirrel World-Space Frob
nodes.rationale: Use Squirrel world-space proximity scanning for selection because card slots/switches lack collision for ray-casts. Publish target back to engine frob globals for native USE.

nodes.label: Smooth Turn KEX Delta Sync
nodes.rationale: Update authoritative display baseline from observed KEX yaw delta during held turns to prevent horizon pitch snap and HMD-yaw offset stacking.

nodes.label: VR Weapon Spread and Recoil
nodes.rationale: Retain skill spread by rotating engine spread delta onto controller ray. Suppress head-kick recoil (nausea) and express it via haptics and viewmodel CameraObj kick.

nodes.label: Weapon Handoff Squirrel Probe
nodes.rationale: Override viewmodel.nut to control CameraObj placement from Squirrel. This avoids unstable native trace rewrites while proving the control surface.

nodes.label: Hitscan Handler Takeover
nodes.rationale: Rewrite trace endpoints in FUN_1403eedd0 (weapon handler) to align shots with the controller ray while preserving KEX's origin and LOS logic.

nodes.label: Stereo Pair-Lock Prediction
nodes.rationale: Predict first-eye pose to the frame where the completed pair submits (2.0 frames) to eliminate jitter in alternate-eye stereo rendering.

nodes.label: POD-only SEH Wrappers
nodes.rationale: Keep SEH wrappers for native calls POD-only to avoid MSVC C2712 errors regarding C++ object unwinding inside __try blocks.

nodes.label: World Ray-Trace Object Filter
nodes.rationale: Filter out low object IDs (floor/walls) in ray-trace interaction to prioritize high-ID interactive objects like switches and keypads.

nodes.label: FUN_1403f3090 (CreatureWeaponAttachWeapon)
nodes.rationale: Ghidra shows this creates/replaces an attached weapon object and stores ownerObj, attachedWeaponObj, and lastRequestedWeapon.

nodes.label: FUN_1401b6310 (WeaponOffset Resolver)
nodes.rationale: Resolves the active WeaponOffset entry for owner/mode; supports lower-risk aim retarget.

nodes.label: FUN_140519380 (PlyrArm Creator)
nodes.rationale: Creates the PlyrArm object.

nodes.label: FUN_1403f25c0 (Creature Attachment Callback)
nodes.rationale: Broad callback that applies creature attachment offsets to attached object positions; likely full-6DOF route.

nodes.label: FUN_1408d2c20 (KEX Config Setter)
nodes.rationale: Native bridge calls this guarded function to feed DLL data into Squirrel/KEX config strings.

nodes.label: Funk Mesh
nodes.rationale: Direct LGMD writer used for VR-clean weapon mesh surgery (forearm trimming) while preserving animation metadata.

nodes.label: OpenXRRuntime
nodes.rationale: Central hub for VR pose data, layer composition (quad/cylinder), and tonal effects.

nodes.label: FlatAim.dll
nodes.rationale: Sidequest DLL for free-aim mouse-look suppression and semantic selection bridge.

nodes.label: Right Hand Pose (ss2vr_aim)
nodes.rationale: Camera-local pose published by DLL for right-hand weapon tracking.

nodes.label: Left Hand Pose (ss2vr_aim_l)
nodes.rationale: Proposed camera-local pose for true left-hand tracking.

nodes.label: FlatAim Heartbeat
nodes.rationale: Private heartbeat signal used to verify the Squirrel bridge is active before enabling FlatAim features.

nodes.label: CameraObj
nodes.rationale: Engine object used for viewmodel rendering and weapon handoff.

nodes.label: Native Overlay Rects Table
nodes.rationale: Native KEX table (50 entries) defining HUD/UI element positions.

nodes.label: Retire FlatAim inverse-cos Bank cancellation
nodes.rationale: v0.15 failed at steep pitches (89.98 degrees) causing gun roll and inversion.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.17 bounded anti-roll
nodes.rationale: Targets mid-pitch roll without reintroducing the v0.15 singularity.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.18 rig-level aimPoint
nodes.rationale: Falsified as a fix for pitch-look roll; rig-level insertion did not become a true screen-space solve.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.19 screen-axis decomposition
nodes.rationale: Failed; near vertical pitch sent horizontal free-aim into Bank.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.20 world-space proxy
nodes.rationale: Exits final CameraObj Euler tuning as it was a low-value path.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.21 Teleport facing order
nodes.rationale: World-object facing order is (roll, pitch, yaw), not CameraObj Heading/Pitch/Bank.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.22 screen-up look-at
nodes.rationale: Proxy needs a roll reference to prevent pitched horizontal aim from turning into Roll.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.24 zero dynamic Roll
nodes.rationale: Tests if removing explicit Roll term alone fixes visual roll.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.25 captured screen-up basis
nodes.rationale: Tests if weapon needs a local screen-up reference tied to the moment FlatAim is entered.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.26 hard roll-kill
nodes.rationale: Answers if visible roll is downstream of FlatAim's explicit Roll channel.

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.28 Dark matrix heading convention
nodes.rationale: Dark source evidence shows heading is atan2(y, x), explaining the pitch-to-roll growth.

nodes.label: FlatAim view-frame aim and native-velocity anchoring
nodes.rationale: Root error was applying screen-space input in the wrong frame; view-frame tangent offsets are the fix.

nodes.label: Separate tracked and fallback weapon scale
nodes.rationale: Apparent scale is pose-mode dependent after native-KEX-frame remap.

nodes.label: Snap-turn v2 accumulator transport
nodes.rationale: Stable route uses KEX normal accumulator plus explicit display-baseline coordination.

nodes.label: Gate Route-B menu pointer on native menu draw
nodes.rationale: Prevents cursor warping during gameplay when RmlUi menus are not active.

nodes.label: Pistol muzzle flash follows via flash-object CameraObj
nodes.rationale: Muzzle flash is a separate object with its own CameraObj, requiring its own tracking script.

nodes.label: Squirrel HitPoints polling for damage FX
nodes.rationale: Avoids reverse-engineered damage RVA while using proven effect-manager path.

nodes.label: Right-arm ammo HUD uses native overlay rects
nodes.rationale: Percentage-based slicing is unstable in inventory mode; native rects are the proven engine seam.

nodes.label: Expand Phase 5.8.1 digital glitch modes
nodes.rationale: GPU path is performant and keeps UI readable; datamosh requires eye-local history.

nodes.label: Detect radiation/toxin through Squirrel properties
nodes.rationale: Uses source-confirmed properties (RadLevel, Toxin) and existing OpenXR composition layers.

nodes.label: FlatAim melee follows melee viewmodel route
nodes.rationale: Melee uses PlyrArm object driven by NDShockMeleeViewmodel, distinct from gun model path.

nodes.label: FlatAim melee preserves native orientation
nodes.rationale: Writing Heading/Pitch/Bank to PlyrArm caused spin/orbit behavior.

nodes.label: FlatAim edge pan via native mouse-look
nodes.rationale: Avoids direct player yaw/pitch writes while keeping ray/proxy based on panned view.

nodes.label: Standalone Funk Extract hands must be static
nodes.rationale: Preserving joint metadata on standalone roots caused AE crashes.

nodes.label: Physical reload visuals as transient objects
nodes.rationale: Suppressing/splitting joint motion is safer than changing BINs to carry gameplay behavior.

nodes.label: VR wrench as authored static LGMD
nodes.rationale: Static LGMD pipeline is strongest; high-detail source is likely embedded LGPMNM payload.

nodes.label: Readable ss2vr_ aliases for authored BINs
nodes.rationale: Stable prefixes make future manual-reload and model-selection code easier to audit and remove noisy exporter suffixes.

nodes.label: LGPMNM tooling read-only status
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental mixing of skinned/AE payload assumptions into known-good static LGMD exporters while unidentified fields remain.

nodes.label: LGMD hierarchy runtime safety validation
nodes.rationale: Parser-clean assets can still be runtime-hostile if subobject links are invalid (e.g., self-sibling cycles).

nodes.label: High vhot IDs for SS2VR metadata
nodes.rationale: Avoids collision with native AE muzzle/eject vhots (0..3) while storing stable model-local positions for VR pivots and grips.
